Name: Seasonal Sam with a Mullet
Author: PixelHag
Description:
[size=6][color=#ff7700]5.0 is now available, completely recoded for the newest version of CP!
Scruffy Sam is now included in the main mod and configurable! No noses or noses, too!

Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MaggPlays?gameId=1303]MaggPlays[/url] for helping me figure out the Calendar Sprites!


[/color][/size][color=#00ff00][size=4][b][u]OLDER CP VERSIONS:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Also includes portrait furniture item replacement![/size]
Thanks to the AMAZING [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14983]Seasonal Outfits Code Template by AirynS[/url] Seasonal Sam is now a stand-alone CP mod!
All art credits are the same for the new CP versions.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits- Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url] no longer required but compatible. 
Also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley - Seasonal Outfits (DSV)
[/url]Simply disable Sam in either mods' configurations.﻿

The previously optional Spirit's Eve costume is included in all CP versions.

If you'd like to learn more about how to use  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14983]Seasonal Outfits Code Template by AirynS[/url] for your own project,
check out my [url=https://pixelhag.com/2024/04/11/sdv-mods-seasonal-outfits-code-template/]blog[/url]﻿!
﻿[left][color=#00ff00][size=5][u]Installation for OLD CP Version:[/u][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and its requirements﻿
[*]Download [CP] Seasonal Sam with a Mullet for 1.6 and unzip. 
[*]Move the [i][CP] Seasonal Sam with a Mullet for 1.6[/i] folder into your Mods folder.
[*]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits- Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley - Seasonal Outfits (DSV)[/url] installed, disable Sam in their configs or through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿.
[/list][/left]
[s]Currently, this mod is an image replacement for Sam if using [/s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits- Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url][s] (or another similar mod), [/s][color=#ffff00][size=4]AS IT WILL NOT DO ANYTHING ON IT'S OWN!!![/size][/color]

[s]This mod is basically just image files to replace files in another mod.[/s] I have mulletfied every sprite and portrait[s] except the Spirit's Eve one( from Seasonal - Cuter), because it doesn't show his hair.[/s] [i]Every time I look at Sam now I think of Keifer Sutherland's character David in The Lost Boys. 

[center]﻿[/center][/i][center][color=#00ff00][size=5]UPDATED FOR 1.6!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!![/size][/color][/center]Soooooo some things have changed!!! Not only did we get 1.6 but the AMAZING [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] added SO much new stuff to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits- Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url] that I have been seeing mullets in my dreams! New Mullets include:

[list]
[*]Vanilla Winter Indoor/Outdoor
[*]Festivals: Egg Festival, Luau, Fair, Ice Festival, Winter Star, Jellies!
[*]A new optional Spirit's Eve Costume (optional only for non-CP version)
[/list]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=5] The art in this mod is not entirely my own:[/size][/color][/u]

All base sprites, the Summer portrait, Flower Dance portrait, and Festival Portraits (minus Winter Ice Fest Portrait outfit and [s]Optional[/s] Spirit's Eve Costume Portrait/Sprite) are taken from the essential﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits- Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url] and were drawn by it's author, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url], with open permissions. 

The Mullet for the sprites were taken from the amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19330](CP) Sam Mullet Replacement[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/136041503]Rosenbug[/url], who gave me permission to use their assets. 

The Mullet for the portraits, the additional shading on Sam's face, and the portrait for Fall were taken from the fabulous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19965?tab=posts&BH=0](CP) Sam's New Mullet[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/81074008]BugboyBehaviour[/url] with open permissions.

The Spring, Winter Ice Fest Portrait, and Optional Spirit's Eve Portrait/Sprite outfits were drawn by me. 

(Legacy Version: Pretty much the same minus the new outfits and the Spring and Winter Indoor/Outdoor outfits are by me, PixelHag.) 

NEW Seasonal Scruffy Sam with a Mullet has all the same permission info as above, with facial hair added by me.

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PkSunflower/about-me]PkSunflower[/url] has been kind enough to add the eyebrow to Sam's surprised/shocked portrait (version 4.5 and 3.0 of Scruffy Sam) that was previously missing. Many thanks!

Basically, I did a lot of cutting and pasting, but Sam is now dateable IMO.﻿ This is my first mod and I'm new to pixel art so if you have any suggestions for me, post away!

[color=#00ff00][size=6][u]How to Install the Non-CP Version:[/u][/size][/color]

[size=5][color=#ffff00]FOR THE 1.6 VERSION YOU NEED THE NEWEST VERSION OF[/color] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450][size=5]SEASONAL OUTFITS - SLIGHTLY CUTER AESTHETIC
[/size][/url][list]
[*][size=4]DOWNLOAD AND INSTALL [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=files]SEASONAL OUTFITS - SLIGHTLY CUTER AESTHETICS[/url]﻿ FIRST[/size]
[*]Download Seasonal Sam with a Mullet and extract (unzip), open the folders until you see the 'assets' folder, STOP.
[*]Open Seasonal Characters - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic's mod folder, [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters, STOP when you see the assets folder. 
[*]Copy Seasonal's Sam's asset folder and paste it into [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters.
[*]YES, you want to replace the files. 
[*]Now Sam has Mullet. Celebrate.
[*](Optional Spirit's Eve Costume installs exactly the same)
[/list]
[youtube]YO4Jt9iqozU[/youtube][center]﻿[/center][center]﻿[/center]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][u]Optional Files for Non-CP Version:[/u][/size][/color]

[color=#ffd966][size=3][i][u]Sam Alternative Spirit's Eve Costume[/u][/i][/size][/color] - Sam as David (Keifer Sutherland) in The Lost Boys. Will replace the original Spirit's Eve costume from Slightly - Cuter. Install the same way as the main file.

[i][color=#ffd966][size=3][u]Seasonal Scruffy Sam with a Mullet for 1.6[/u][/size][/color][/i] - Same as the main mod only gives Sam a 5 o'clock shadow as well as the mullet. This mod also includes the alternative Spirit's Eve costume so it won't need to be downloaded separately. (I chose to do this so I wouldn't need to bother the original artist for permission right now. I know they are a mod author and have mods to update or are maybe even trying to play 1.6. If I see a need to, I will ask their permission eventually to use the original portrait but for now, mine will have to do!)

[size=6]IF YOU'RE NEW TO MODDING AND NEED GENERAL HELP GO HERE: [/size][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started][size=6]Modding: Player Guide/Getting Started[/size][/url]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][u]Future Plans:[/u][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][s]Update the Winter Ice Fest Portrait to be more in line with the vanilla style.[/s]
[*][s]Update whenever [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits- Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url] does[/s] No longer needed.
[*][s]Make a Content Patcher version[/s]
[/list]
 
Banner image shows cute little mullety Sam sleeping in his gorgeous room thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url]﻿.

[color=#ffd966][size=5]A HUGE thank you to all of the artists who graciously allow others to use their work. Without Poltergeister, Rosenbug, BugboyBehaviour, and AirynS [/size][/color]this mod would not exist. Please pay them a visit and give them some love!
